dataset_support_summary: In 151, Axin2, Nkd1, Notum, Wnt9b and Wnt4 increased with FDR support within a 390-DEG response; 145 had seven DEGs including Axin2. The same perturbation yielded no FDR-supported downstream genes in 20 other measured groups.

summary: Grin2b perturbation recurrently down-regulated Eef1a2 in 21 of 23 measured cell groups, spanning glutamatergic and GABAergic populations; 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut and 215 MB Dopa were the only null groups by FDR.

missing_or_conflicting_edge: The literature does not establish whether Ttyh1 loss should phenocopy or avoid the Atp2a2-loss UPR; the consequential comparator-divergence edge is missing.
